Name: Denver to NPC Adventures
Author: andril11
Description:
[size=3]This is a content pack for Npc adventures, that brings Denver as a full companion to an adventure![/size]

[size=3]Denver has an wild spirit that awaken yours too!

[/size][size=5]Install instructions[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]Npc adventures[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Instal the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594]Denver[/url]﻿ [/size]
[*][size=4]Drop everything inside of your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=4]Launch the game via SMAP[/size]I
[/list]
